slots.slot: Lead story — March NAC feature (Atlantic City)
slots.title: A National Tournament Next Door: March NAC Comes to Atlantic City
slots.summary: The much larger March NAC article you asked for on Nov. 16. Mar. 5–8, 2027, Atlantic City Convention Center, Y10/Y12/Y14/Division II, free for spectators. Who can enter (Y14 age only; Y10/Y12 need one RYC or SYC this season, and Cobra is an SYC; Div II = C/D/E/U), fees ($225/$320/$415, triple after Jan. 6), late entry until 5 p.m. the night before, $250 no-show fine, GRACE fee waivers. Closes with who's already in: Noah Gore, Caden Wu, Christina Jiang, Mila Siu (6 entries). Withdrawal deadline left out (the page contradicts itself). Schedule not posted yet.

slots.title: The Touch He Gave Back
slots.summary: FIE Annual Awards (Budapest, Sunday): world junior No. 1 Kruz Schembri (U.S. Virgin Islands, 20) shares the 2026 Fair Play Trophy for refusing a touch at 13–13 against Davide Di Veroli at the Senior Worlds; he lost 15–13. Co-winner: French armorer Gilles Martinage, who fixed his failed blades. Adds the season's epee No. 1s (Santuccio, Elsayed, Prošina). From FIE's own articles.
